# Supply Software Project — Octopart API
> Software projects for solution templates, evaluation kits and reference designs, with their parameters and compatibility.

Schema slice: [schema.graphql](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/schema.graphql) (~6194 tokens). Overview: [overview](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/overview.md).

## Entities
- [SupSoftwareProject](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/types/objects/sup-software-project.md): Software Project — A software project published in the supply catalog, together with the evaluation kits it is compatible with. GRID `grid:supply::platform:software-project/{id}`. Via: supSoftwareProjectById, supSoftwareProjectsByIds, supSoftwareProjectEvalKitCompatibleSoftwareProjectsByEvalKitId, supSoftwareProjectEvalKitCompatibleSoftwareProjectSearch, supSoftwareProjects, …

## Entry points
- [supSoftwareProjectById](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/queries/sup-software-project-by-id.md): Search a specific software project by its unique identifier.
- [supSoftwareProjectsByIds](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/queries/sup-software-projects-by-ids.md): Search a specific software project by its unique identifier.
- [supSoftwareProjectEvalKitCompatibleSoftwareProjectsByEvalKitId](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/queries/sup-software-project-eval-kit-compatible-software-projects-by-eval-kit-id.md) (list): Get evaluation kit compatible software projects.
- [supSoftwareProjectEvalKitCompatibleSoftwareProjectSearch](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/queries/sup-software-project-eval-kit-compatible-software-project-search.md) (list): Searches evauation kit compatible software projects.
- [supSoftwareProjects](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/queries/sup-software-projects.md) (list): List a reference solutions.
- [supSoftwareProjectSearch](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/queries/sup-software-project-search.md) (list): Searches software projects.
- [supSoftwareProjectSolutionTemplateSoftwareProjectsBySolutionTemplateId](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/queries/sup-software-project-solution-template-software-projects-by-solution-template-id.md) (list): Get software projects associated with a solution template.

## Queries
- [supSoftwareProjectEvalKitCompatibleSoftwareProjectIdsByEvalKitId](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/queries/sup-software-project-eval-kit-compatible-software-project-ids-by-eval-kit-id.md): Get evaluation kit compatible software project idenfitiers.
- [supSoftwareProjectParameterInfos](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/queries/sup-software-project-parameter-infos.md): List all available software project parameter definitions.
- [supSoftwareProjectSolutionTemplateSoftwareProjectIdsBySolutionTemplateId](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/queries/sup-software-project-solution-template-software-project-ids-by-solution-template-id.md): Get software project identifiers associated with a solution template.
- [supSoftwareProjectSolutionTemplateSoftwareProjectsBySolutionTemplateIds](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/queries/sup-software-project-solution-template-software-projects-by-solution-template-ids.md): Get software projects associated with multiple solution templates, grouped by solution template identifier.

## Mutations
- [supSoftwareProjectCreateSoftwareProject](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/mutations/sup-software-project-create-software-project.md): Create a new software project.
- [supSoftwareProjectDeleteSoftwareProject](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/mutations/sup-software-project-delete-software-project.md): Delete a software project.
- [supSoftwareProjectPatchParameters](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/mutations/sup-software-project-patch-parameters.md): Add or remove parameters on a software project.
- [supSoftwareProjectPatchPreviewImages](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/mutations/sup-software-project-patch-preview-images.md): Patch preview images on a software project: add, delete, or reorder.
- [supSoftwareProjectPatchSoftwareProjectSolutionTemplates](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/mutations/sup-software-project-patch-software-project-solution-templates.md): Add or remove software project associations on a solution template.
- [supSoftwareProjectSetParameters](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/mutations/sup-software-project-set-parameters.md): Replace all parameters on a software project.
- [supSoftwareProjectSetPreviewImages](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/mutations/sup-software-project-set-preview-images.md): Replace all preview images on a software project.
- [supSoftwareProjectSetSoftwareProjectSolutionTemplates](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/mutations/sup-software-project-set-software-project-solution-templates.md): Replace all software project associations on a solution template.
- [supSoftwareProjectUpdateEvalKitCompatibleSoftwareProject](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/mutations/sup-software-project-update-eval-kit-compatible-software-project.md): Update evaluation kit's compatible software project.
- [supSoftwareProjectUpdateSoftwareProject](https://altiumdeveloper.github.io/octopart-api-docs/reference/supply-software-project/operations/mutations/sup-software-project-update-software-project.md): Update a software project.
